meta.title: Casa de Pasto Fernanda e Campinas — Traditional Portuguese restaurant in Vila Nova de Cacela
meta.description: Family-run tavern in Vila Nova de Cacela, Algarve. Traditional Portuguese cuisine: petiscos, fresh fish, charcoal-grilled meats, Iberian pork and Mãe Fernanda's specialities.

hero.subtitle: Timeless flavours in the heart of the Algarve. Petiscos, charcoal grills and Mãe Fernanda's specialities.

about.title: Our house
about.body: We are a family-run casa de pasto, where the cooking is done the way it always has been: with fresh produce, time and the genuine taste of Portuguese cuisine. From chicken açorda to wild boar stew, every dish is made by hand and served as if at home.

specialties.title: Mãe Fernanda's specialities
specialties.subtitle: Slow-cooked pot dishes, made with time. Advance booking required.
